introduce: Sit with your feet flat on the floor and your knees bent at a 90-degree angle. Keep your back straight and your hands behind your ears.\n\nRaise your right knee, and use your left elbow to touch your right knee. Change sides and repeat.
name: CHAIR ELBOW TO KNEE CRUNCH

tips.text: Tighten your abdominals during the exercise.
Raise your knee up as high as you can.
Squeeze your abdominals with each crunch.
Exhale as you lift your knees and inhale when lowering them.
This exercise works on your entire core.

introduce: Sit upright with your feet flat on the floor. Keep your back straight and your hands behind your ears.\n\nBend at your waist and squeeze obliques to one side as far as possible. Hold for a count, and return to the starting position. Switch to the other side and repeat.
name: CHAIR SIDE BEND

tips.text: Keep a straight back and braced core during the exercise.
Exhale as you bend to the side, and inhale as you return.
You can feel your obliques and lower back stretched.

introduce: Sit down with your heels on the ground and your knees slightly bent.\n\nAlternately lift your legs and clap under your knees.
name: CHAIR CLAP CRUNCH

tips.text: Exhale when you lift your knees, and inhale when you lower them.
To get more of a challenge, keep your leg straight.
If you feel it's too easy, lift your feet a bit, keeping them from touching the ground.
You should feel your abdominals burning, maybe even shivering.
This primarily targets your abdominal muscles.
